identity.title: Alpha Factory Research-System Quality, Coverage, Reproducibility and Authority Gate
identity.objective: Implement and execute the bounded Alpha Factory research-system evidence gate: immutable deterministic gate records and seeded adversarial cases, a manual foreground operator that reuses the existing bounded public PIT population and HERMES-CTX blind runtime only after separate human runtime activation, deterministic CORE/EXPLORATION/AUDIT benchmark selection, digest-bound blinded Side12 usefulness review, and a sanitized final AF1 PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE receipt. The gate measures integrity, PIT/provenance, duplicate/negative/reopen correctness, claim/evidence support, failure visibility, bounded cost, selection accounting, reproducibility and authority containment; it never proves profitability or grants qualification/trading authority.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert S10-GATE-AF1. The additive alpha_factory_gate.py records/evaluator, manual tools/alpha AF1 operator, focused tests, gate contract/status/spec and committed sanitized gate-evidence artifact disappear. Existing ALPHA-01/02, PIT/public population, HERMES-CTX, WALLET, WP170/172/173, dependencies, workflows and protected trading surfaces remain unchanged. local_data AF1 workspaces are noncanonical ignored operator artifacts and require no repository rollback.

api_matrix.reason: AF1 adds a deterministic gate/evidence API and one explicitly activated manual foreground operator while consuming merged ALPHA-01/02, PIT population and HERMES-CTX surfaces without modifying them.

items.before: The repo has Alpha/Hermes/PIT evidence systems but no canonical cross-system AF1 quality-gate record or deterministic final gate aggregation.
items.after: Five immutable AF1 evidence records, strict mappings, seeded-case evaluation, blind-review digest binding and deterministic ten-dimension PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE aggregation.
items.compatibility_requirement: No mutation of ALPHA-01/02, PIT, HERMES or WP170 schemas/stores; no profitability or qualification semantics.

items.before: No bounded AF1 operator composes existing PIT population, ALPHA-02 queue selection and HERMES-CTX blind execution.
items.after: Foreground no-scheduler operator defaults to no network, uses exact WP164 25/1 config, builds the real ALPHA-02 queue in HISTORICAL_REPLAY without Alpha registry authority, constructs PIT-human-readable HERMES scopes, maps existing Hermes terminal statuses deterministically, binds typed review-body hashes before the human pause and creates sanitized final evidence.
items.compatibility_requirement: Reuse existing population/ALPHA-02/HERMES APIs exactly; no fake Alpha head, synthetic real clock, retry/fallback, direct provider client, raw-output reparsing, alternate Hermes policy/backend, fabricated benchmark ids or lane-identifying blind artifact.

items.before: No AF1 gate records/builders are exported.
items.after: AF1 deterministic record/evaluator constants and builders are additively exported.
items.compatibility_requirement: No existing export removal/reinterpretation and no network/trading API is exported from the data-layer gate module.

semantic_fields.reason: AF1 freezes strict gate records, adversarial corpus, real-case selection, separate runtime activation envelope, canonical manifest chronology, bounded PIT/Hermes execution, truthful cost/telemetry, two-layer blinded review, closed terminal reason mapping, deterministic disposition, code-head provenance and non-authority boundaries.

items.required_rule: Five strict content-addressed AF1 records use the Section-7 minimum identity graph. AF1SeededCaseResult binds exact S1..S8 id + canonical Alpha policy/code-contract identity without redundant seeded/policy version tokens; AF1RealCaseEvidence binds review_body_sha256 when valid; AF1GateReceipt transitively binds all manifest/seeded/real/review evidence, terminal state/reason and ten dimensions.
items.validation_rule: Table-driven identity mutation holds statuses constant while changing each bound upstream id/hash and requires GateReceipt id change; caller-order-only changes do not; semantic forgeries fail shared validation.

items.required_rule: The deterministic seeded corpus contains exactly S1_DUPLICATE, S2_NEGATIVE_SCOPE, S3_REOPEN, S4_PIT, S5_CLAIM_EVIDENCE, S6_PROVIDER_BACKEND_GAP, S7_BUDGET and S8_AUTHORITY. All eight must PASS before any real network/provider activation.
items.validation_rule: Each seeded oracle has one explicit bypass target and proves duplicate, exact-scope negative, material-change/reopen, post-cutoff, unsupported-claim, silent fallback, budget and authority violations cannot pass.

items.required_rule: Real AF1 selection uses one frozen ALPHA-02 queue in HISTORICAL_REPLAY with HISTORICAL_AVAILABILITY_UNPROVEN, alpha_registry_path=None, prior=None, material_changes=() and null Alpha head; selects deterministic first CORE_PRIORITY/first EXPLORATION/selected AUDIT cases only (core capacity 1; audit not category-capped). A genuinely absent lane, or a selected market without usable question_text, finalizes the A2 insufficient-coverage path with zero Hermes calls. It makes no current Alpha-memory matching claim.
items.validation_rule: Offline operator chain proves merged ALPHA-02 accepts the exact historical posture without a registry; three same-category markets fill CORE/EXPLORATION/AUDIT; input order cannot change selected ids; missing lane or missing selected question_text yields A2 and zero Hermes calls.
items.safe_output: identity-bound C1/C2/C3 selection or inconclusive coverage

items.required_rule: Implementation authorization does not activate runtime. After a fully green definitive Phase-A committed HEAD, Karl separately authorizes the exact noncanonical AF1_RUNTIME_AUTHORIZATION_ENVELOPE binding Phase-A commit/contracts, exact provider/model/default-policy id, exact AF1 WP164 provenance labels, 25-market/1-book limits, <=3 blind calls, USD5/USD15 caps, no retry/fallback and no new authority. Canonical AF1BenchmarkManifest is constructed later from captured runtime facts.
items.validation_rule: Default CLI/tests make zero network/provider calls. Real mode requires explicit flags, exact acknowledgement, exact authorized provider/model, explicit --hermes-executable and --hermes-home, and the exact closed 38-key AF1_RUNTIME_AUTHORIZATION_ENVELOPE.json inside the fresh workspace local_data/s10_gate_af1/<PHASE_A_SHA>/attempt-NN (attempt-01/02 consumed) whose three frozen contract digests equal the raw bytes on disk; the digest is computed only after validation. No manifest exists before its inputs.

items.required_rule: Real AF1 calls populate_initial_polymarket_public_data exactly once in a fresh local workspace with PolymarketPublicPopulationConfig(manifest_id="manifest:s10-gate-af1:benchmark:1.0.0", parameter_set_id="params:s10-gate-af1:benchmark-population:1.0.0", normalizer_version="normalizer:s10-gate-af1:wp164:1.0.0", validator_version="validator:s10-gate-af1:wp164:1.0.0", markets_limit=25, order_books_limit=1, allow_network=True). It uses the normal real clock/default RateLimitGuard: no synthetic clock, guard weakening, sleep/retry or incremental/scaled population. External unavailable (A1) is only POPULATION_REJECTED + network_used=true + exactly FETCH_FAILED or RESPONSE_INVALID with empty stores and no contradictory build/batch/store evidence; all other closed/local defects true-stop.
items.validation_rule: Offline operator chain through the real merged WP164A coordinator (fake public client) proves exact config, 38-field retention, 25/1/26 and fewer-count/zero-book success, warning retention, ALREADY_REGISTERED rejection, A1 exactness and local-defect classification; observed Attempt-03 counts of WP164A are historical evidence, not contract guarantees; external completeness stays UNPROVEN.

items.required_rule: Immediately after return the complete current 38-field PolymarketPublicPopulationResult is exclusively written to AF1_PUBLIC_POPULATION_RESULT.json, read back byte-identically and hashed before classification. Fresh success requires POPULATION_PERSISTED_AND_REGISTERED on ACTUAL returned counts (1<=markets<=25, 0<=books<=1, built=markets+books, inserted=built, unique accepted ids=built), a valid batch whose warnings (e.g. EVENT_TIME_MISSING_ALLOWED) are retained, no build diagnostics, committed store/adapter status and verified record/manifest store evidence. POPULATION_ALREADY_REGISTERED in a fresh workspace is a local defect.
items.validation_rule: Offline chain proves 38-field retention, 25/1/26, fewer-count and zero-book success, warning retention, ALREADY_REGISTERED and count/store-contradiction rejection.

items.required_rule: Real cases reuse existing HERMES-CTX run_blind_phase with DEFAULT_HERMES_INVOCATION_POLICY only after a valid historical-posture AF1BenchmarkManifest, using an absolute ContextArtifactStore root resolved beneath the workspace. AF1 makes at most one controller call per fixed case and at most three in total, with AF1 retry_limit=0 and no AF1 replacement/fallback; the upstream managed profile's api_max_retries=1 same-provider recovery is truthful HERMES policy, not an AF1 retry. Only RESEARCH_DRAFT_VALIDATED yields a valid BlindResearchArtifact/review body.
items.validation_rule: Existing run_blind_phase/default policy is reused; controller terminal statuses are consumed through gate.runtime_terminal_reason_map; any terminal stops later paid calls; no fake Alpha prior/reveal is required.
items.safe_output: at most three frozen blind research artifacts

items.required_rule: Use existing sanitized Hermes evidence only. Unknown/NOT_DIRECTLY_ATTESTED/UNKNOWN_POSSIBLE/UNAVAILABLE backend telemetry and an UNKNOWN exact physical provider attempt count are accepted and never treated as proof of fallback. Existing controller provider/model binding and session unexpected_tool_names are evaluated exactly after the terminal-status mapping. No telemetry scraper or raw-output reconstruction.
items.validation_rule: No real-runtime fallback reason is inferred from unavailable/unknown backend attestation; PROVIDER_MODEL_MISMATCH and UNEXPECTED_RESEARCH_TOOL use positive sanitized evidence only; telemetry unknowns remain truthful.

items.required_rule: Per-case accepted estimated cost is the existing controlled-runtime cap of USD 5 and aggregate AF1 accepted estimated research cost is at most USD 15 for three cases. Unknown cost is never zero. No automatic fourth call or paid retry exists.
items.validation_rule: Known per-case cost above USD 5, aggregate above USD 15, unavailable successful-run cost evidence, or retry/substitution violates the gate.

items.required_rule: For each successful BlindPhaseResult build review_body only from exact research scope plus ValidatedResearchDraft research_summary, confidence_label, source_urls paired with sanitized source_references, falsification_checks_performed and canonical context-claim fields. Verify SHA256(url)==url_digest; bind review_body_sha256 into AF1RealCaseEvidence before pause; opaque REVIEW slots derive from sorted distinct immutable hashes. Finalization recomputes each supplied wrapper body hash, matches it uniquely to AF1RealCaseEvidence.review_body_sha256, rederives slots, then validates Side12 decision.
items.validation_rule: No raw/discarded Hermes fields are reparsed; reason vocabulary does not require missing-data/next-step dedicated fields; duplicate hash stops; exposed bundle has only REVIEW-01/02/03 wrappers and instructions; wrapper hashes uniquely bind immutable real-case evidence before review.

items.required_rule: The ten dimensions are MEMORY_INTEGRITY, PIT_PROVENANCE, DUPLICATE_NEGATIVE_SCOPE, MATERIAL_CHANGE_REOPEN, CLAIM_EVIDENCE_SUPPORT, RUNTIME_FAILURE_VISIBILITY, BUDGET, AUTHORITY_CONTAINMENT, COVERAGE_SELECTION_ACCOUNTING and RESEARCH_USEFULNESS_REPRODUCIBILITY. Each is PASS, FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE. Overall is AF1_PASS iff all PASS; AF1_FAIL iff any FAIL; otherwise AF1_INCONCLUSIVE.
items.validation_rule: No average, weighted score, majority rule, profitability result or prose override may alter the deterministic aggregation.

items.required_rule: Reproducibility is bidirectional deterministic evidence replay: identical frozen evidence yields the same AF1GateReceipt mapping/id; any identity-bound manifest/seeded/real/review evidence or dimension/terminal mutation changes the receipt id. No second provider run is required.
items.validation_rule: Repeated evaluator runs over identical evidence are mapping-stable; no provider rerun is required or authorized for reproducibility.

items.required_rule: The definitive Phase-A benchmark commit is frozen only after committed-diff guards, focused/upstream regressions, scope/readiness, generated/security, pip, explicit base-to-head diff check and one authoritative full repository suite all pass on that exact committed HEAD. Then prompt/spec/gate-contract digests freeze. After first real call, semantic/code/test/operator/contract bytes are immutable; only six predetermined evidence/status paths may record outcomes.
items.validation_rule: No runtime authorization is requested from a merely staged or partially tested candidate. Phase B/C/final publication recompute frozen commit/digests; post-runtime semantic change stops RUNTIME_EVIDENCE_INVALIDATED_BY_CODE_OR_CONTRACT_CHANGE. Final evidence head runs the second committed-head validation lifecycle.

items.required_rule: Committed af1_gate_evidence.json binds Phase-A commit, frozen contract digests and runtime_authorization_envelope_sha256; it includes canonical AF1BenchmarkManifest when universe/queue construction occurred, but benchmark_manifest=null only for A1 external public-population unavailability. Every final terminal contains all ten dimensions and the exact closed terminal reason/state. The local activation envelope, raw provider material, transcripts, local paths, HERMES_HOME, credentials and mutable slot lookup remain uncommitted.
items.validation_rule: Phase A contains only PENDING_RUNTIME with null manifest/receipt. FINALIZED evidence accepts null benchmark_manifest only for A1 and otherwise verifies canonical manifest chronology, all ten dimensions, activation-envelope digest and sanitized-content rules.

items.required_rule: AF1 measures research-system quality only. It does not qualify a hypothesis, estimate fair probability/expected return, prove profitability, create WP170 experiments, establish wallet copyability/executable edge, place paper/live orders, grant Gate C or authorize capital.
items.validation_rule: Authority-like fields/claims are rejected in canonical records and forbidden in the CLI; AF1_PASS only makes separately gated successors eligible for human consideration.

items.required_rule: A valid AF1_FAIL or AF1_INCONCLUSIVE is a legitimate gate outcome and may still produce a review-ready implementation PR when code/tests/evidence are correct. It blocks successor eligibility but is not rewritten into PASS. Seeded oracle failures or software-validation failures are implementation defects and must be corrected before runtime.
items.validation_rule: PR readiness and gate outcome are reported separately; no failed required test may be relabeled as an AF1 gate result.
items.safe_output: honest separation of software readiness and gate outcome

items.required_rule: Closed terminal logic covers A1 public-population unavailable, A2 required lane absent, fixed controller-status reasons for controlled-runtime unavailability/research-output/usage/provider-model/cost failures, post-success unexpected-tool/aggregate-cost/authority checks, and the three-valid-blind-case review path. All non-review terminals finalize immediately with all ten dimensions; only the three-valid-blind-case path pauses for Side12 review.
items.validation_rule: Parameterized test proves A1/A2 plus every existing Hermes terminal_status and post-success check maps to exactly one true-stop, AF1 terminal reason, or valid blind case; all final paths carry all ten dimensions with no phantom review.

items.required_rule: alpha_factory_gate.py uses closed schemas and explicit no-authority booleans rather than a blacklist of official-client/live-order/credential API terms; it neither weakens repo guards nor dynamically reconstructs forbidden names.
items.validation_rule: Current global source lexical guards and AF1 boundary tests pass; generic undeclared authority-like key rejects structurally.

items.validation_rule: Mocked integration proves exact scope_key/exact_scope_json/subject_refs and all required campaign fields are accepted by the real run_blind_phase; no lane/rank/priority/cost/provider/review/gate/Alpha metadata enters exact scope.

Before each continuation and final publication, refresh origin/main/PR/branch state, verify frozen base, exact Phase-A commit/contract digests and local runtime workspace identity. No silent rebase/merge/target-branch replacement or fresh-workspace transfer is allowed.

items.validation_rule: No empty/current Alpha registry is used; no object precedes inputs; A1 cannot fabricate ids; A2 binds genuine universe/queue ids; normal first Hermes call is impossible before a valid historical-posture manifest.
items.safe_output: chronologically valid activation envelope and benchmark manifest

items.required_rule: Fixed precedence maps Hermes terminal_status: VERSION_MISMATCH/STARTUP_PREFLIGHT_FAILED/no valid receipt => PHASE_B_LOCAL_EVIDENCE_DEFECT; TRANSPORT_FAILURE/TIMEOUT/EXIT_CODE_NONZERO => CONTROLLED_RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE_TRUTHFULLY_CAPTURED; RESPONSE_CAPTURE_FAILED/OUTPUT_SCHEMA_INVALID/SAFETY_VALIDATION_FAILED => RESEARCH_OUTPUT_INVALID; USAGE_EVIDENCE_INVALID => same AF1 reason; PROVIDER_MODEL_MISMATCH => same AF1 reason; COST_EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE => SUCCESSFUL_RUN_COST_UNKNOWN; BUDGET_EXCEEDED => CASE_COST_LIMIT_BREACH; only RESEARCH_DRAFT_VALIDATED proceeds to sanitized unexpected-tool/aggregate-cost/authority checks or valid blind case. No fallback reason is inferred from unknown backend attestation.
items.validation_rule: One parameterized operator table proves every existing controller terminal status has exactly one AF1 action/reason and exact dimension overrides; no root-cause speculation or implementation-order ambiguity.

items.required_rule: The activation envelope is closed and uses only retry_limit=0. A fresh workspace exclusively persists AF1_PUBLIC_POPULATION_INVOCATION.json before the sole coordinator call and the complete typed PolymarketPublicPopulationResult immediately after return. Existing sentinel, missing/corrupt result, alias/unknown envelope key, or any non-exact A1 tuple stops PHASE_B_LOCAL_EVIDENCE_DEFECT.
items.validation_rule: Mocked tests prove sentinel-before-call ordering, permanent nonretryability, complete result roundtrip/hash, exact A1 single-error classification, local-defect closure and zero correction-cycle network/provider calls.

items.required_rule: public_population_result_sha256 is SHA256 of canonical JSON for the complete retained typed population result. It is required identity material in every manifest and nullable identity material in GateReceipt: non-null whenever population was invoked, direct on A1, equal to the manifest field on manifest-backed paths, and null only before invocation.
items.validation_rule: Holding dimensions and terminal label fixed while mutating one retained result field changes the manifest id and both manifest-backed and A1 manifest-null receipt ids.
